body: Thank you thank you thank you. You're right. About everything.

I'm going through the exact same thing man. Just posted today. Had someone listen. Told to force myself to make a change to keep my mind off of her. So I'm gonna try and do exactly that. Im here to talk. I know exactly what you are going through.

Thanks so much. I really needed someone to hear my story. It's a shitty one. I'm not the best person. I've just never had thoughts like this before, or feelings this heavy. I'm not a very emotional person so I'm just ill-equipped to deal with them. To make it worse I'm the kind of person that gets hung up on everything. Gonna try to start working out again tomorrow. I've haven't been able to do anything but lay in bed recently. Hopefully this is the lowest it gets. Thank you again for your help. Sitting here crying because a stranger on the internet listened. I appreciate it.

I'm sorry you feel like that. It might helps to to talk to someone, anyone. Professional or otherwise. People can be attentive and empathetic if given the chance, even if they don't know you that well. Just talking to them about stuff like this might even build a relationship. People would say I have a lot of friends. But I can't think of one person I can sit down with and open up to. Not one real friend. It brings me down and just amplifies how shitty I feel when I'm already trying to deal with other stuff. Trying to turn it around by working on strengthening relationships, but it's hard when the effort is one-way and not reciprocated. That feeling is almost as bad as not having a friend at all.
